PRETTIEST GIRL IN THE WORLD TURNS 17

Roshan Still Reportedly Speechless One Year After First Hello; Officially Mine Since October 8, 2026

BY ROSHAN · SPECIAL CORRESPONDENT

On this auspicious first day of December, witnesses across Pune and Nalkheda confirm that the world officially marks seventeen luminous years since Vaishnavi arrived and raised the standard of beauty for every universe.

Exactly one year ago today, a single birthday message turned two familiar strangers into inseparable confidantes—proving once and for all that the best stories begin when you least expect them.

✦ SOCIETY BULLETIN · OCT 8, 2026 ✦

OFFICIALLY FOREVER: Archives confirm that on October 8, 2026, Vaishnavi officially became Roshan's forever person—for this lifetime and every reality after. Close sources report he has not stopped smiling since.

WEATHER DESK · PUNE ⇄ NALKHEDA

Forecast: 100% chance of being missed. Highs of endless forehead kisses; clear skies tonight under the exact same moon.

CERTIFIED FOREVER 08 · 10 · 2026

PENDING BALANCE: 1,000,000 hugs & kisses. Strictly non-refundable.
